summary: Zoom provides APIs, webhooks, and SDKs via the Zoom App Marketplace. Developers can build OAuth apps to access Zoom data on behalf of authorized users.

verdict.label: Medium
verdict.approval_required: Depends on the scopes used and whether the app is published to the marketplace.

prerequisites.text: A Zoom account with access to the Zoom App Marketplace to create an OAuth app.

steps.title: Review developer documentation
steps.detail: Review the official Zoom developer guides and SDK documentation to plan your integration architecture.

steps.title: Log into Zoom App Marketplace
steps.detail: Sign in to the Zoom App Marketplace using your developer account credentials.

steps.title: Create an OAuth App
steps.detail: Select and create an OAuth app type to obtain your client credentials and configure your redirect URIs.

steps.title: Configure Scopes and Endpoints
steps.detail: Configure the necessary API scopes and set up your backend endpoints to handle OAuth callbacks and webhook events.

approval.summary: Publishing an app or using specific restricted scopes may trigger a review process by Zoom.
triggers: Publishing to the Zoom App Marketplace
